set.body:
Scope: Generic helpers in image, transform and spatial; image4s/locus4s/reframe4s/graph4s/Gale.

Deliverable: For each actual consumer, use an existing provider API or add the missing generic capability upstream. Cover filters, masks, clustering/local statistics, neighborhoods, reductions, graph routing and numerical operators according to their invariants.

Acceptance:
- Every moved generic helper has one implementation; provider capabilities have direct JVM/JS tests and an actual consumer.
- No neuro-specific types enter generic provider APIs; anatomical policy stays in domain adapters.
- Core types are used directly without duplicate axis/domain/map/field/metadata/registry models; ordering and allocation behavior are retained.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: I1: Remove generic image and spatial helpers into their core owners
